mapper.select: select id, dates, pkg, user_type, click_user_num, click_record_num, show_user_num, show_record_num, create_time from dws_daily_pkg_ad_event where dates = #{dates}

SELECT ddpaae.id, duedq.dates, duedq.pkg, duedq.user_type, duedq.click_user_num, duedq.click_record_num, duedq.show_user_num, duedq.show_record_num FROM (SELECT dued.dates, dued.pkg, 0 user_type, COUNT(DISTINCT case dued.event_id when 'ds_click' then dued.user_id end) click_user_num, COUNT(case dued.event_id when 'ds_click' then dued.user_id end) click_record_num, COUNT(DISTINCT case dued.event_id when 'ds_show' then dued.user_id end) show_user_num, COUNT(case dued.event_id when 'ds_show' then dued.user_id end) show_record_num FROM dwd_user_event_detail dued inner join dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = dued.user_id) where dued.dates = #{dates} and dued.event_id in ('ds_click', 'ds_show') GROUP by dued.dates, dued.pkg) duedq LEFT JOIN dws_daily_pkg_ad_event ddpaae on (ddpaae.dates = duedq.dates and ddpaae.user_type = 0)

SELECT ddpaae.id, duedq.dates, duedq.pkg, duedq.user_type, duedq.click_user_num, duedq.click_record_num, duedq.show_user_num, duedq.show_record_num FROM (SELECT dued.dates, dued.pkg, 1 user_type, COUNT(DISTINCT case dued.event_id when 'ds_click' then dued.user_id end) click_user_num, COUNT(case dued.event_id when 'ds_click' then dued.user_id end) click_record_num, COUNT(DISTINCT case dued.event_id when 'ds_show' then dued.user_id end) show_user_num, COUNT(case dued.event_id when 'ds_show' then dued.user_id end) show_record_num FROM dwd_user_event_detail dued inner join dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = dued.user_id and dui.dates = dued.dates) where dued.dates = #{dates} and dued.event_id in ('ds_click', 'ds_show') GROUP by dued.dates, dued.pkg) duedq LEFT JOIN dws_daily_pkg_ad_event ddpaae on (ddpaae.dates = duedq.dates and ddpaae.user_type = 1)
